# stockproof

> A browser-only replacement for Shopify's retired Stocky app. Shopify and WooCommerce merchants load the CSV exports their store already makes and get reorder suggestions, purchase orders, barcode labels, a stock count with a write-back file, and (Plus) receiving against a purchase order with margin per line. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

- Site: https://arthi-arumugam-git.github.io/stockproof/
- Source: https://github.com/arthi-arumugam-git/stockproof
- Author: Arthi Arumugam, https://wrong-numbers.dev/

## What it answers
- Shopify retired Stocky on 31 August 2026; what replaces its purchase orders, reorder suggestions and stock counts?
- How do I get reorder quantities from a Shopify inventory export and an orders export without an app?
- How do I print barcode labels or run a stock count from a WooCommerce product export?

## Pricing
- Standard: $19 a month or $190 a year
- Plus: $39 a month or $390 a year (receiving with margin per line, per-vendor lead times)

## Facts a reader can check
- Shopify's inventory export has no SKU column; stockproof joins it to the products export.
- Write-back files keep Shopify's own "On hand (current)" and "On hand (new)" columns so an import cannot silently overwrite a count.
- WooCommerce column names are quoted from woocommerce.com's documentation of the Products, Variations and Stock reports and the product CSV importer.
